_comment: M28.4.3 remove_uds_member soak-only. Marked skip_inspect: true to match M28.4.1/M28.4.2 scope. The soak gate validates byte-identity across 2 rounds of a destructive op — round 1 removes BpxRemovalCandidate from the UDS_BpxTestEmpty duplicate (which arrives with {BpxAutoBool, BpxRemovalCandidate}, leaving just BpxAutoBool), round 2 sees BpxRemovalCandidate already absent and hits the idempotent skip="member already absent" path. Destructive-op idempotency is load-bearing here because the soak harness re-applies the same plan and round 1 already deleted the target — same pattern M28.5.2 remove_eqs_test had to harden against. UUserDefinedStruct's bAllowToMakeEmpty=false engine invariant (StructureEditorUtils.cpp:327) is NOT exercised by this fixture because the pre-remove struct has 2 members (can drop to 1); see the M28.4.3 shipped block for the structured error path on would-empty-struct.
